title: Rapid-navigation direct screenshot evidence supplement
geometry_convention: Zero-based half-open integer [left, top, right, bottom) crops and solid opaque masks only.
interpretation_limits: Direct still screenshot only; no continuous-video or atomic-every-frame guarantee.
The recorded action/observation timestamp is from the corresponding JSON, not printed in the screenshot.
Event-list times and messages are UI values, not independent SDK snapshot execution timestamps.
Captured value rows are below this viewport; the Values heading alone is not visual proof of those captured values.
No new product finding or persistent source-association failure is claimed.
The 1.487-second action-record span is not a measured UI settling duration.
The later settled observation does not establish a maximum transition latency or every-frame consistency.
Source-link identity was checked from recorded URLs, which are intentionally excluded from this pack.
